summary: Banco Macro S.A., the Argentine parent of SEC registrant Macro Bank Inc., filed a 6-K furnishing a CNV notice dated November 5, 2026, disclosing purchases of its own Class B common shares under Section 64 of Law 26,831. The bank bought 685,000 Class B shares (par value Ps$1, one vote each) at an average Ps$9,735.013 per share for an aggregate Ps$6,668,484,135. This is a US-equivalent issuer repurchase/buyback disclosure rather than a formal tender offer; no price range, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or timetable is stated. Watch for cumulative repurchase disclosures, treasury-share limits and any tender mechanics that follow.
